thesis: After the opening period, a completed 15-minute bar that extends below session VWAP and closes near its low can earn a two-hour long-only mean-reversion rebound.
rationale: A causal coarse screen found the minus-10-basis-point VWAP distance, minus-10-basis-point one-bar return, sub-0.3 range position, and post-120-minute family produced roughly 125 observations and positive six-basis-point-cost average returns across all chronological segments. Only adjacent holding periods are tested to limit multiplicity.
